exploit_name: Unoptimized subset match counting exceeds gas limits causing permanent draw settlement DoS
description: Implementation regenerates subsets inside nested loops. With 16M USD pool, bonusballMax reaches 129, causing gas consumption of ~25.8M exceeding Base chain's 25M limit.
root_cause: Implementation regenerates subsets inside nested loops. With 16M USD pool, bonusballMax reaches 129, causing gas consumption of ~25.8M exceeding Base chain's 25M limit.
fix_description: Cache subsets before the bonusball loop. Apply a hardcoded bonusballMax limit.
notes: Pyth entropy callback cannot execute, preventing drawing settlement permanently. Protocol deadlocked.
